Strictly inside means -5 < x < 5 and -4 < y < 4. That gives x from -4 to 4 (9 values) and y from -3 to 3 (7 values), so 9 × 7 = 63.

Solution 1 is wrong because it subtracts the wrong boundary count from an unrelated larger rectangle. Solution 3 is wrong because it ignores the axes: the points with x = 0 or y = 0 are inside the rectangle but get left out. Solution 2 gives 63, which matches.

CHOICE: 2
